pages.text: The Divine Heavenly Dao is $(l)about 50 blocks tall$(), drifts through terrain to hover over you, and fills the air with an oppressive hum while it lives. It is $(l)immune to all ranged attacks$() and enrages nearby Endermen.$(br2)All three of its attacks have a wind-up:

$(li)$(l)Earthshaker$(): both arms rise while a ring of sparks marks the ground, then it smashes down. Entities standing on the ground take 50 damage and are thrown 20 blocks up, so $(l)jump$() at the right moment.$(li)$(l)Thunder Ring$(): 18 lightning bolts fall at random around it, spreading out past 20 blocks, 100 damage each.$(li)$(l)Heaven's Strike$(): a charged direct blow for 50 damage.
At low health it enters $(l)phase two$(): it heals every second, attacks faster and summons 3 dragon-sized $(l)Giant Withers$(). While they live the Boss takes half damage, so clear them first.
Drops 4-8 Heavenly Dao Fragments, Enchanted Golden Apples, a Dragon Egg and Nether Stars. Fragments craft the S-tier gear.
